metadata.title: WR-VIII: The Cosmological Fibre: Universes Compatible with Our Universe Today — Distance responses, curvature completion and global ambiguity (v0.1)
metadata.description:
English mathematical draft and complete Russian translation. A first-branch FLRW kinematic carrier admits an explicit curvature/expansion completion class for an ideal calibrated distance profile. Independent expansion rates refine it. Free supernova and BAO calibration scales retain a joint scale symmetry. A polynomial distance benchmark gives finite identification and deterministic interval certificates. Restricted classical patch protocols admit distinct flat spatial topologies, and smooth kinematic histories admit different futures.

Полный русский перевод включён в ту же запись. Работа разделяет идентификацию фона на наблюдаемом интервале, абсолютную калибровку, глобальную топологию и временное продолжение. Рисунки и демонстрация являются аналитическими и синтетическими, а не подгонкой космологических каталогов.

REVIEWABLE_DRAFT. Standard cosmological identities are attributed. No new gravity theory, observational fit, fixed-matter admissibility, exhaustive novelty certification or independent peer review is claimed. This version has not been deposited.
